findings.text: When the captured stack has fewer than three frames after the header, `stackWithoutTwoTopLines` is now `''`. The original regex did not match in that case and left the stack unchanged. `endsWith('')` is always true, so the request-side stack is never appended to `err.stack`. With a dummy stack of `at a\nat b` and an existing `err.stack`, the original appended it and the new code drops it.
